# Fixture: SYNTHETIC. Not captured from a running server.
# Constructed from the SGLang tokenizer metrics collector read at source:
#   python/sglang/srt/observability/metrics_collector.py @ 54cadad (2026-09-04)
#   TokenizerMetricsCollector, label dict built in
#   python/sglang/srt/managers/tokenizer_manager.py
#
# Re-transcribed 2026-09-05. The first transcription omitted is_streaming,
# which the collector adds to the two token counters and to those alone:
#   prompt_tokens_total / generation_tokens_total:
#       labelnames=list(labels.keys()) + ["is_streaming"]   (lines 1519-1528)
#   cached_tokens_total:
#       labelnames=list(labels.keys()) + ["cache_source"]   (line 1599)
# A server that answers both streaming and non-streaming requests therefore
# emits each token counter as two lines. Reading one of them is reading part
# of the total.
# Series names cross-checked against the SGLang repo's own consumers:
#   test/registered/observability/test_metrics.py:178-180 (asserted present)
#   python/sglang/benchmark/one_batch_server.py:65,71 (parsed by prefix)
#
# Shape this fixture exercises (ADR-014 D1/D4):
#   - cached_tokens_total split across cache_source: device, host, and a
#     dynamic storage_<backend> this parser has never been told about.
#   - a cache_source="total" line alongside them. The two paths are
#     mutually exclusive per request but the counter is cumulative, so a
#     server upgraded mid-run carries both. It is excluded by name, not by
#     whitelisting the sources: the sum here is 1800+400+120 = 2320.
#   - _created lines, which prometheus_client emits beside every counter
#     and which an exact name match must not pick up.
#   - a second model, and label orders where model_name is not first.
#   - the two token counters split across is_streaming. The totals are
#     unchanged from the first transcription (3400 = 2900+500 prompt,
#     512 = 480+32 generation): what changed is that reading a single line
#     no longer reads the total.
#
